description: Straßen des Straßen- und Wegenetzes der Hanse- und Universitätsstadt Rostock is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.sv.rostock.de. This dataset includes the roads and paths of the road network of the Hanseatic and University City of Rostock with information on name, key, code and network sections. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Roads of the road network of the Hanseatic and University City of Rostock" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
